name: Privacy browser setup
pitch: A step-by-step guide to configure a privacy-focused browser with extensions and settings.
instructions: Start by searching the web for "privacy-focused browser setup guide" and list the top results. Open each result and extract the recommended extensions and settings. If no useful guide is found, say so and ask the person if they have a specific browser in mind. Collect the names of the extensions and the setting changes into a list. Use make_page to create a new Markdown document titled "Privacy Browser Setup Guide" and paste the list into it. Show the finished guide to the person and ask if they would like to install any of the suggested extensions.
starters: set up my browser for privacy

examples.ask: what is a good privacy browser
examples.does: search the web for privacy-focused browsers and list the top three options

skills.name: find-privacy-guides
skills.description: Search the web for a privacy-focused browser setup guide.
skills.body: 1. Use web_search with the query "privacy-focused browser setup guide". 2. Review the results and open the most relevant pages with web_fetch. 3. Scan each page for lists of extensions and specific setting changes. 4. If a page does not contain useful information, close it and move to the next result. 5. If no results contain a helpful guide, stop and inform the person.

readme:
# Privacy Browser Setup

Creates a step-by-step guide to configure a browser for maximum privacy. Uses web search to find reliable guides, extracts recommended extensions and settings, and outputs a Markdown document.

**Needs**: web_search, web_fetch, make_page.

**Will not**: install extensions or change browser settings automatically. Always shows the guide to the person first and asks before any action is taken.
